title: Oncogene-mediated nuclear accumulation of lactate promotes epigenetic alterations to induce cancer cell proliferation.
authors: Bandopadhyay, Shreya; Kamal, Izaz M; Padmanaban, E; Ghosh, Damayanti D; Chakrabarti, Saikat; Roy, Sib S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PITX2通过糖酵解和核内乳酸积累影响表观遗传促进卵巢癌增殖，虽含MD模拟乳酸-HDAC互作，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅间接涉及转录因子，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Homeobox gene families are associated with embryonic development and organogenesis. Pieces of evidence suggest that these Homeobox genes are also crucial in facilitating oncogenesis when mutated or overexpressed. Paired homeodomain transcription factor-2 (PITX2), one of the members of this family, is involved in oncogenic regulation apart from its different development regulatory functions. PITX2 has been earlier shown to induce ovarian cancer cell proliferation through the activation of different signaling cascades. Increased cancer cell proliferation requires a constant supply of nutrients for both adenosine triphosphate and biomass synthesis, which is facilitated by altered cancer cell metabolism that includes enhanced glucose uptake and increased glycolytic rate. This present study highlights the involvement of PITX2 in enhancing the cellular glycolysis pathway in ovarian cancer cells through protein kinase B-phosphorylation (phospho-AKT). PITX2 expression correlates positively with that of the glycolytic rate-determining enzyme, lactate dehydrogenase-A (LDHA), in both high-grade serous ovarian cancer tissues and common ovarian cancer cell lines. Interestingly, transient localization of enzymatically active LDHA in the nucleus was observed in PITX2-overexpressed ovarian cancer cells. This nuclear LDHA produces higher concentrations of the glycolytic end product, lactate, which accumulates in the nuclear compartment resulting in decreased histone deacetylase (HDAC1/2) expression and increased histone acetylation at H3/H4. However, the mechanistic details of lactate-HDAC interaction are still elusive in the earlier reports. Our in silico studies elaborated on the interaction dynamics of lactate in the HDAC catalytic core through ligand-binding studies and molecular dynamics simulation approaches. Blocking lactate production by silencing LDHA reduced cancer cell proliferation. Thus, PITX2-induced epigenetic changes can lead to high cellular proliferation and increase the size of tumors in syngeneic mice as well. Taken together, this is the first report of its kind to show that the developmental regulatory homeobox gene PITX2 could enhance oncogenesis through enhanced glycolysis of tumor cells followed by epigenetic modifications.
abstract_zh: 同源盒基因家族与胚胎发育和器官形成相关。证据表明，这些同源盒基因在突变或过表达时也在促进肿瘤发生中至关重要。配对同源结构域转录因子-2（PITX2）是该家族成员之一，除其不同的发育调控功能外，还参与致癌调控。PITX2此前已被证明通过激活不同信号级联诱导卵巢癌细胞增殖。癌细胞增殖增加需要持续的营养供应，以支持三磷酸腺苷和生物质合成，这由改变的癌细胞代谢促进，包括增强的葡萄糖摄取和增加的糖酵解速率。本研究强调了PITX2通过蛋白激酶B磷酸化（phospho-AKT）增强卵巢癌细胞中细胞糖酵解途径的作用。PITX2表达与糖酵解限速酶乳酸脱氢酶-A（LDHA）的表达在高级别浆液性卵巢癌组织和常见卵巢癌细胞系中均呈正相关。有趣的是，在PITX2过表达的卵巢癌细胞中，观察到酶活性LDHA的瞬时核定位。这种核LDHA产生更高浓度的糖酵解终产物乳酸，乳酸在核区室中积累，导致组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC1/2）表达降低，并增加H3/H4处的组蛋白乙酰化。然而，乳酸-HDAC相互作用的机制细节在早期报告中仍不明确。我们的计算机模拟研究通过配体结合研究和分子动力学模拟方法详细阐述了乳酸在HDAC催化核心中的相互作用动态。通过沉默LDHA阻断乳酸产生可减少癌细胞增殖。因此，PITX2诱导的表观遗传改变可导致高细胞增殖，并增加同系小鼠中肿瘤的大小。综上所述，这是首次报道表明发育调控同源盒基因PITX2可通过增强肿瘤细胞糖酵解及随后的表观遗传修饰来促进肿瘤发生。
